# FluentU

> > FluentU is a video-based language learning platform that teaches languages through authentic content with interactive subtitles and vocabulary tools.

FluentU offers educational solutions for schools and learners across multiple languages including Mandarin, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Italian, Korean, and Portuguese. The platform uses real-world videos with context-based vocabulary learning to create immersive language experiences.

## Key Topics

- Video-based learning
- Interactive subtitles
- Vocabulary in context
- Authentic content
- Mandarin Chinese
- Spanish language
- French language
- German language
- Japanese language
- Educational platform
- Academic pricing

- Multi-language support
